contents.contents: Rite of Epiphany (ܬܩܕܝܣ ܐܠܡܐ ܝܘܡ ܥܝܕ ܐܠܓܛܐܣ), fol. 1v-6v; rite of Palm Sunday (ܪܬܒܗ̈ ܐܠܫܗܢܝܢܗ̈ ܘܙܝܐܚܗܐ), fol. 6v-13v; rite for Holy Thursday (ܪܬܒܗ̈ ܐܠܓܣܠ), fol. 13v-14v; rite for Good Friday (ܙܝܐܚ ܐܠܨܠܝܒ), fol. 14v-15v; rite for Easter (ܙܝܐܚ ܐܠܨܠܝܒ ܝܘܡ ܥܝܕ ܐܠܩܝܐܡܗ̈), fol. 15v-22r; rite for the Pentecost (ܪܬܒܗ̈ ܐܠܥܢܨܪܗ), fol. 22r-36v; hymns for Good Friday (ܬܪܬܝܠ ܝܩܐܠ ܦܝ ܙܝܐܚ ܐܠܨܠܝܒ), fol. 36v-38v; procession of the Holy Body, (ܙܝܐܚ ܐܠܓܣܕ); fol. 38v-41v; rite for the sick (ܪܬܒܗ̈ ܐܠܩܢܕܝܠ), fol. 41v-49v; rite of anointing of the sick (ܪܬܒܗ̈ ܐܠܡܫܚܗ̈), fol. 49v-51v; last rites (ܨܠܘܐܬ ܥܠ܀ ܐܠܡܢܐܙܥܝܢ), fol. 51v-62r; prayers for the ill person (ܨܠܘܬ ܥܠܝ ܐܠܡܪܨ݁ܝ), fol. 62r-78v; prayers on the woman who gave birth (ܨܠܘܐܬ ܒܝܬ ܐܠܘܐܠܕܗ) fol. 78v-81r; rite of baptism (ܐܠܡܥܡܘܕܝܗ̈), fol. 81v-90r; funeral rites for a) men, fol. 90v-97r b) woman, fol. 97r-103v, and c) monks, fol. 106r-113v; prayers to drive away reptiles, fol. 114r-115v; prayers on the liturgical clothes, fol. 115v-116r; hymns and litanies (ܬܪܐܬܝܠ ܘܛܠܒܐܬ) fol. 116v-144r; marial sisterhood's prayers (ܬܘܒ ܐܠܣܝܕܗ ܘܐܠܘܪܕܝܗ) fol. 144r-164r; hymns (ܕܘܟܣܐ ܟܐܬܝܣܡܐ) fol. 164v-185v; prayers for the use of the priest (ܨܠܘܐܬ ܐܣܬܥܕܐܕ ܐܠܟܐܗܢ) fol. 185v-201v and exorcism (ܬܩܣܝܡ) fol. 201v-213v
contents.notes: Rites designated by Metropolitan ʻAbd Allāh and Metropolitan Jirmānūs Farḥāt in 1748 CE at Dayr Sayyidat Luwayzah, according to fol. 1v; a summary of the distinction of the Roman faith on fol. 1r; texts on fol. 104r-105v, 138r-143v and 201v-213v are most likely from different hand and differents from the whole manuscript
